summary: Cannot sign in to the portal after changing the password
resolution: The account was resynchronised and a new sign-in link was sent

summary: The verification code never arrived on the registered phone
resolution: The contact number was verified and the code was resent

summary: The portal rejects a PDF attachment during upload
resolution: The file was compressed and renamed before a successful upload

summary: The bus arrived more than thirty minutes late
resolution: An additional trip was assigned and passengers were notified

summary: The new bus route is missing from the mobile map
resolution: The route dataset was refreshed and the map was reloaded

summary: The location of the neighbourhood bus stop is unclear
resolution: A location link was sent and a sign was added

summary: No appointments are available at the requested clinic
resolution: A waiting list was opened and a nearby clinic was suggested

summary: The laboratory result is missing from the health application
resolution: The result was synchronised with the health record

summary: The prescription renewal action fails in the application
resolution: Eligibility was checked and the renewal request was reactivated

summary: The permit request rejected the uploaded document
resolution: The required format was explained and upload was reopened

summary: The permit status has remained under review for a week
resolution: The request was escalated and its status was updated the next day

summary: The permit fee was charged twice
resolution: The duplicate amount was refunded and one payment was retained
